---
title: "Module: `EOSSDK_UserInfo`"
---

Tier A (2020 `eossdk_userinfo.*`). Caches remote peers' account display info, fetched over the peer mesh. 12 methods.

## 1. Identity & handle
`EOS_HUserInfo` via `EOS_Platform_GetUserInfoInterface`.

## 2. Class shape & base mixins
`IRunCallback` (+ network in 2020 via `kUserinfo`). No `OnNetworkMessage` in the named set — the newer build's inbound handler may be a helper or folded into Connect infos; **follow-up to confirm** how remote userinfo arrives (2020 had `userinfo_info_request`/`userinfo_info` messages).

## 3. Member state
- `_userinfos`: cache `EOS_EpicAccountId -> UserInfo{country,displayname,preferredlanguage,nickname}` (self seeded by `setup_myself` at platform init).
- `_userinfos_queries`: pending `QueryUserInfo` results keyed by target.
- `EmuInit` @`0x180190390` / `EmuDeinit` @`0x180192160`.

## 4. Lifecycle
`EmuInit` registers callbacks + frame (+ network listener in 2020). `setup_myself` seeds own info from Settings (username, language).

## 5. Synchronous accessors
- `CopyUserInfo` @`0x1801912f0` (alloc `EOS_UserInfo`, `EOS_UserInfo_Release` contract).
- `CopyBestDisplayName` @`0x180191c20`, `CopyBestDisplayNameWithPlatform` @`0x180191da0` (may return `EOS_UserInfo_BestDisplayNameIndeterminate`).
- External-account user info: `GetExternalUserInfoCount` @`0x180191690`, `CopyExternalUserInfoByIndex/ByAccountType/ByAccountId` (@`0x1801917a0`/`0x180191920`/`0x180191aa0`).

## 6. Async operations
- `QueryUserInfo` @`0x180190580` — standard FrameResult recipe; if not cached, stash in `_userinfos_queries[target]` + send `userinfo_info_request`; resolved on inbound `userinfo_info` (→ `EOS_UserInfo_QueryUserInfoCallbackInfo`) or timed out (`EOS_TimedOut`) in `CBRunFrame`.
- `QueryUserInfoByDisplayName` @`0x180190db0`... @`0x1801908b0`, `QueryUserInfoByExternalAccount` @`0x180190da0` — resolve by name/external id.

## 7. Notifications
None (no `AddNotify*`).

## 8. Network protocol — RESOLVED: none in this build
The newer build has **no `EpicUserInfo_pb` message and no UserInfo network handler** (confirmed from the embedded protobuf descriptors — see `protocol.qmd`). A peer's display name/username arrives instead via the **`EpicEmu_Infos_pb.username`** handshake (`EOSSDK_Client` emu-info exchange) and `EpicPresence_pb`. So `QueryUserInfo` resolves from the local cache populated by those two channels rather than issuing its own request. (2020 had a `UserInfo_Message` request/reply; it was removed.)

## 9. Frame/tick
`CBRunFrame` times out stale `_userinfos_queries` (`EOS_TimedOut`).

## Reimpl notes / follow-ups
- Reimpl: cache display info per EpicAccountId; request from peer on miss; answer requests with own info from Settings.
- Follow-ups: (1) locate/confirm the inbound userinfo handler in the newer build; (2) `CopyBestDisplayNameWithPlatform` platform-tagging behavior; (3) external-user-info source (likely Connect external-account mappings).
